regions.text: 带三章挠的俁然なり羅

quote.translation: Just as a stone thrown into the air falls back, it is possible that the moon will fall to the earth tonight; it is possible that the King of Turkey will convert to Christianity, become a Catholic priest and become Pope of Rome.

regions.text: 带三章挠的俁然なり羅馬法玉となることも可能である。單に形式約に「何々が可能である」とい。ふ言薬は淺薄で空歳なるのである。『殊に哲學に於ては、何々が可能」であるとか、または「なほ他のこと」も可能であるとか云つたり、またはよく人が言ふやうに何何が「思催できる」と云つたりするやうなことがあつてはならない』（Hegel,Encyktopi-tie,

quote.translation: Words such as "such and such is possible", taken merely formally, are shallow and empty: "Especially in philosophy, there should be no talk of saying that such and such is 'possible', or that 'something else too' is possible, or, as people often say, that such and such is 'thinkable'" (Hegel, Encyklopädie, hrsg. v. Bolland, § 143, S. 191-192; Wissenschaft der Logik, hrsg. v. Lasson, II, S. 171).
We can, however, also think the opposite.

regions.text: 43,S.191-192;WissenschaftderLogik,hrsg.v.Lasson,I,SI71）°然し我々は反對に考へることも出來る。

quote.translation: Without completely cutting the content off from its concrete connection, as Hegel describes, we can think disjunctive possibility, and with it disjunctive contingency, while preserving a certain moderate concreteness.

regions.text: ヘーゲルが云ふやうに具體的開聯から内容を全然切離すことをしないでも或る適度の具體性を保つたまま離接的可能性従つて離接偶然性を考へることが出來る。トルョ王が羅馬法王になることを考へないでもミソロンギを包園したイプラヒムパシャが偶々砲彈に當つて残れ、よルュ軍

quote.translation: Even without imagining the King of Turkey becoming Pope, it is not necessarily irrational to think of the case in which Ibrahim Pasha, besieging Missolonghi, happened to be struck by a cannonball and fell, the Turkish army raised the siege, and Byron did not die in a foreign land.

regions.text: 開みを解き、バイロンが客死しなかつたといふ場合を考へることは必ずしも不合理ではない。また反對に、具體を十分脱しきらないで中途に止まるために不合理が生ずる如き場合には、更に具體を離脱して抽象へ行くことにょつて、不合理性を解消することが出來る。

quote.translation: Conversely, where irrationality arises because we have stopped halfway, without fully leaving the concrete behind, we can dissolve the irrationality by leaving the concrete still further behind and going over into the abstract.

regions.text: 抽象へ行くことにょつて、不合理性を解消することが出來る。今晩、月が地球へ落ちて來るといふ

quote.translation: That the moon will fall to the earth tonight is very markedly encumbered by the concreteness of time and space.

regions.text: 今晩、月が地球へ落ちて來るといふのはなほ考しく時間と空間との具體性にわづらはされてゐる。我々は宇宙の生

quote.translation: If we think instead of the case in which, in the formation of the universe, the moon was never made, this is not necessarily irrational, and even if we think of the case in which the earth too was never made and man never arose, it cannot be called irrational.
